description.en: The IDs of the image pipelines. You can specify up to 20 IDs.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。取值范围：1~500。

默认值：50。
description.en:
The number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 500.

Default value: 50.
The name of the image pipeline.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。
description.en: The pagination token. To retrieve the next page of results, set this parameter to the `NextToken` value from the previous response. Omit this parameter on your first request.

description.zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh:
企业资源组ID。使用该参数过滤资源时，资源数量不能超过1000个。

>不支持默认资源组过滤。
description.en:
The resource group ID. If you use this parameter for filtering, you can query a maximum of 1,000 resources.

> Filtering by the default resource group is not supported.
The key of a tag. Up to 20 tags are supported.
The value of a tag. Up to 20 tags are supported.

title.zh: 查询镜像模板的详细信息

descriptions.zh: 您可以设置`NextToken`查询凭证（Token），其取值是上一次调用`DescribeImagePipelines`返回的`NextToken`参数值，再通过`MaxResults`设置单页查询的最大条目数进行查询。
descriptions.en: To perform a paginated query, set the `NextToken` parameter to the `NextToken` value returned by the previous `DescribeImagePipelines` call, and use the `MaxResults` parameter to specify the maximum number of entries.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-image-pipelines --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --name testImagePipeline --next-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --max-results 50 --image-pipeline-id ip-2ze5tsl5bp6nf2b30000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeImagePipelines --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --NextToken AAAAAdDWBF20000 --MaxResults 50 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ImagePipelineId.1 'ip-2ze5tsl5bp6nf2b30000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name testImagePipeline
